title: Single-reference in-context image segmentation literature and repository evidence
scope: Literature research grounded in existing repository evidence; no new scientific experiments or encoder calls.

search_accounting.definition: Sum of numResults, including duplicates and irrelevant results; not a count of unique papers or full-text reads.

sources.name: One-Shot Learning for Semantic Segmentation
sources.fact: Support-conditioned segmenter; offline learned parameters.

sources.name: PANet: Few-Shot Image Semantic Segmentation with Prototype Alignment
sources.fact: Foreground/background prototypes and episodic prototype alignment.

sources.name: PFENet
sources.fact: Training-free prior submodule inside a supervised feature-enrichment system.

sources.name: Hypercorrelation Squeeze for Few-Shot Segmentation
sources.fact: Frozen backbone does not remove supervised training of 4D correlation aggregation and decoder.

sources.name: CyCTR
sources.fact: Cycle-consistent support-pixel selection for learned cross-attention.

sources.name: Few-Shot Segmentation Without Meta-Learning: A Good Transductive Inference Is All You Need?
sources.fact: Base-class supervised features; per-task support CE, query entropy and foreground-proportion KL. Oracle size is diagnostic.

sources.name: Images Speak in Images: A Generalist Painter for In-Context Visual Learning
sources.fact: Multi-task supervised in-context image completion; initial preprint 2022, CVPR 2023.

sources.name: SegGPT: Segmenting Everything In Context
sources.fact: Mixed segmentation supervision and random coloring; one-example inference does not imply no task training.

sources.name: In-Context Segmentation via Training-Free Semantic Correspondence (SegIC)
sources.fact: Frozen visual correspondence plus trained decoder and geometric/visual/meta instructions; check text use and data overlap by variant.

sources.name: SINE: A Simple Image Segmentation Framework with In-Context Examples
sources.fact: Identity, instance and semantic ambiguity handled by different outputs; interaction and decoder are trained.

sources.name: SANSA
sources.fact: Frozen SAM2 with supervised AdaptFormer adapters; strict/generalist training settings differ.

sources.name: SAM 3
sources.fact: Concept segmentation with text and same-image exemplar boxes; not a native cross-image full-mask reference interface.

sources.name: Toward Robust In-Context Segmentation via Concept Guidance
sources.fact: Qwen3-VL-4B inferred concepts and SAM3 search; reference/query concatenation for exemplar grounding; no user-supplied extra class name required.
sources.caveat: Standard and robustness evaluation samples differ. Repository creation is not first-publication date.

sources.name: Iris
sources.fact: 3D UNet trained from scratch for medical context segmentation; not frozen natural-image DINO.

sources.name: UNICL-SAM: Uncertainty-Driven In-Context Segmentation with Part Prototype Discovery
sources.fact: Trained uncertainty modeling, graph augmentation/refinement and part prototypes; prior art for generic uncertainty-graph novelty.

sources.name: Semi-Supervised Learning Using Gaussian Fields and Harmonic Functions
sources.fact: Graph-based harmonic inference is established prior art; not a directly evaluated ICS baseline.

sources.name: Personalize Segment Anything Model with One Shot
sources.fact: PerSAM frozen; PerSAM-F fits two scale weights. Original emphasis includes personalized instance segmentation.

sources.name: Matcher: Segment Anything with One Shot Using All-Purpose Feature Matching
sources.fact: DINOv2 and SAM, forward/reverse matching, hierarchical prompts, candidate selection/merging.

sources.name: Bridge the Points: Graph-based Few-shot Segment Anything Semantically
sources.fact: FG/BG-guided points, point-mask coverage graph and overshooting controls.

sources.name: DINOv3
sources.fact: Dense self-supervised representation and Gram anchoring; backbone is not a complete ICS algorithm.

sources.name: Revealing the Semantic Selection Gap in DINOv3 through Training-Free Few-Shot Segmentation
sources.fact: Original ViT-B/512; five prototypes per class including background plus support Gram energy. GT layer oracle is not deployable selection.
sources.caveat: FROST reruns use ViT-L/1024. Metric global confusion aggregation and resize implementation must be pinned.

sources.name: INSID3: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation with DINOv3
sources.fact: Raw intra-image features, debiased cross-image features, support-mask candidate filtering, query seed/region aggregation; paper CRF distinct from optional API default.
sources.caveat: Clustering has no explicit spatial connectivity constraint.

sources.name: FROST: Training-Free Few-Shot Segmentation with Frozen Features and Nonparametric Statistics
sources.fact: Within-class whitening, normalized FG/BG KDE log ratio, support LOO bandwidth, propagation; includes horizontal-flip observations.
sources.caveat: Six-domain 1-shot average trails strongest comparator in paper. Code/paper differ in propagation feature space, score kernel, spatial norm, LOO class weighting; this does not establish invalid results.

sources.name: FoRIS: Progressive Foreground Refinement for Training-Free In-Context Segmentation
sources.fact: Foreground purification, localization and consolidation; DINOv3-L/1024 and complete CRF evaluation.
sources.caveat: Author eight-domain table is not local ten-domain table; thin-structure layer/resolution issues already studied by authors.

sources.name: No time to train! Training-Free Reference-Based Instance Segmentation
sources.fact: Frozen DINOv2/SAM2 prototype memory and semantic-aware soft merging; main COCO uses multishot instance AP.
sources.caveat: Correct arXiv identifier is 2507.02798; not 2507.01300 appearing in a secondary bibliography.

sources.name: REBASE
sources.fact: Reference-background low-rank projection of support and query, followed by SAM points and dense prior. DINOv3 tested in supplement.
sources.code_status: official repository says code release coming soon
sources.caveat: v1/v2 background coverage threshold differs; README/paper values differ. Do not describe official code as reproduced.

sources.name: HERA
sources.fact: Support-conditioned source-free adaptation updates a small MLP subset; not no-gradient frozen inference.
sources.caveat: Earliest located public posting predates arXiv; withdrawn ICLR submission and later CVPR version distinguished.

sources.name: Overcoming Support Dilution
sources.fact: Support pruning and correlation modeling; additional/noisy support need not help under studied learned FSS setting.

sources.name: A Novel Benchmark for Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation in the Era of Foundation Models
sources.fact: N-way K-shot needs N*K support images; adaptation rather than strict novel-class generalization.
sources.caveat: One-shot is not a single labeled image total; downstream class split does not prove pretraining novelty.

sources.name: FAME
sources.fact: Multi-anatomy/modality medical evaluation, zero/ten-shot and separate target-absence reliability.
sources.caveat: Not a matched one-reference ranking or replacement for local ten-domain objective.

limitations: Literature claims are author reports, not new reproductions.
R1/R2/R3 are development evidence; C1 is a distinct, now-exposed confirmation cohort.
Official external source/runtime execution was not tested.
Repository contains concurrent changes; do not infer snapshot contents from HEAD alone.
